ranked.headline: Statistical frameworks resolve spatial cell co-localisation and cell communication
ranked.summary: Multi-sample, multi-condition spatial datasets call for significance testing that accounts for spatial structure and cell density.

ranked.headline: Learned models map sequence and structure onto antibody, TCR and MHC recognition
ranked.summary: Sequence- and structure-based models now span antibody developability, de novo antibody design, MHC presentation and influenza antigenic profiling.

ranked.headline: Multimodal models fuse histology, omics and clinical data for cancer outcomes
ranked.summary: Multi-omic, histopathology and cfDNA datasets are now paired with learned models that link these readouts to clinical endpoints.

ranked.headline: Multi-objective generative models design molecules, peptides and antibodies in silico
ranked.summary: Preprints and papers now pair generative models with multi-objective optimization to balance several in silico predictors at once.

ranked.headline: Auxiliary consistency and priors guide biomolecular structure evaluation and prediction
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs language models and ensemble or cross-consistency priors with structure to predict biomolecular interactions and model quality.

ranked.headline: Sequence models tune translation and infer microbial substrate use and expression
ranked.summary: Recent work extends sequence inference to non-model microbes, translation control, and metatranscriptomic differential expression benchmarking.

ranked.headline: Structure-based pose datasets and learned models prioritize ligands and targets
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair pose datasets, proteome-wide docking, and learned models with benchmark or validation performance.

ranked.headline: Single-cell models are tested for generalization across perturbations and modalities
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply flow matching, foundation-model layer analysis, and multi-omic disentanglement to single-cell perturbation and integration tasks.

ranked.headline: Multimodal perturbation screens map chromatin, morphology, and metabolic states at scale
ranked.summary: Automated and single-cell perturbation platforms now pair large perturbation spaces with multimodal readouts across 3D genome, morphology, and transcription.

ranked.headline: Graph models predict drug and RNA associations; XAI tests binding-site attributions
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks pair graph neural predictors with attribution checks, testing whether model explanations match chemically meaningful sites.

ranked.headline: Structure-based models predict protein interactions at residue and network scales
ranked.summary: Proteome-wide AlphaFold-Multimer predictions and CALVADOS-based simulations now enable residue-level interaction inference at network scale.

ranked.headline: Spatial simulations link dendritic cell arrangement to T cell activation dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple agent-based, PDE, and Boolean models to capture spatial constraints on T cell activation and CAR-T dynamics in tissue.

ranked.headline: Variant effect interpretation extends beyond missense to indels and structural variants
ranked.summary: Clinical evidence calibration for in-frame indel predictors and tissue-resolved dosage metrics for structural variants are now reported together.

ranked.headline: Stochastic B cell state dynamics accelerate antibody affinity maturation models
ranked.summary: Germinal center modelling and lineage-benchmarking tools now probe how non-genetic and stochastic dynamics shape antibody evolution.

ranked.headline: Simulations map amyloid aggregation-prone regions in α-synuclein, Aβ42 and DPF3
ranked.summary: Experimental restraints, sequence-based predictors, and coarse-grained fibril models are now coupled to simulation across several amyloidogenic systems.

ranked.headline: Software tools for peptide matching, PROTOMAP visualization and cross-link origin
ranked.summary: Recent tools package peptide matching, MaxQuant visualization, and cross-link confidence scoring into accessible software for proteomics workflows.

ranked.headline: Projecting kidney GWAS heritability onto disease-remodeled single-cell states
ranked.summary: Single-cell atlases now enable attributing trait heritability, sex effects, and age-linked variability to specific cell types and genes.

ranked.headline: Genomic context shapes regulatory element function across species and tissues
ranked.summary: Cross-species atlases and interpretable models now place regulatory elements within their genetic, methylation and chromatin context.

ranked.headline: Structure-guided models prioritize candidates in biosynthesis, binder design, DEL screens
ranked.summary: Genome-scale mining and glycan-aware design now pair docking, MD, and co-folding with candidate ranking.

ranked.headline: Ortholog and genome comparison tools underpin cross-organism homology inference
ranked.summary: The 2026 DIOPT update and the Genomica R package add ortholog-based tools for cross-organism and metagenomic analysis.

ranked.headline: Gapless and pangenome assemblies extend reference genome resources across taxa
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair long-read sequencing with graph and telomere-to-telomere methods to build more complete reference resources.

ranked.headline: Computational methods reconstruct and interrogate metabolic networks from omics data
ranked.summary: Repository-scale metabolomics knowledgebases and multi-omics data demand verifiable, standardized computational models of metabolism.

ranked.headline: Protein language models infer phage tail fiber function and bacterial host specificity
ranked.summary: Recent PhageHost and DposFinder publications pair protein language models with phage tail fiber and depolymerase prediction for bacterial host specificity.

ranked.headline: Deep generative models infer molecular structures and benchmark MS data at scale
ranked.summary: Generative models now map tandem mass spectra to molecular structures while large, continuously reprocessed datasets enable systematic benchmarking.

ranked.headline: Generative models steered toward design objectives across protein sequence and structure
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair generative models with explicit conditioning, search, and conformational sampling for protein, antibody, and RNA design.

ranked.headline: MS-based computation maps prokaryotic glycosylation and microbial sugar precursors
ranked.summary: Two new preprints apply untargeted, spectrum-driven inference to microbial glycan biology, extending mass spectrometry analysis beyond predefined target lists.

ranked.headline: Generalist and boundary-aware models are reshaping biomedical image segmentation
ranked.summary: Generalist segmentation models are now benchmarked across live microscopy, spatial omics, and volume EM, exposing quality gaps.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks question whether biological sequence foundation models beat simpler baselines
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test whether pretrained DNA, molecular, and single-cell models outperform random or classical baselines under standardized benchmarks.

ranked.headline: MSA depth and clustering choices govern fidelity of structural models and trajectories
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks and pipelines quantify which input and evaluation choices determine the completeness and scoring of structural models.

ranked.headline: Computational frameworks for inferring gene perturbation effects from single-cell data
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs scalable single-cell estimators with explicit statistical or simulation frameworks for perturbation and trajectory inference.

ranked.headline: Minimal models expose adhesion, discretization, and noise as migration constraints
ranked.summary: Minimal models now separate genuine adhesion and polarity constraints from numerical artifacts and molecular noise in simulated cell migration.

ranked.headline: Standalone R and GUI tools now target epigenomic, cytometry, and replication-timing data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints package epigenomic, cytometry, binding and replication-timing analyses as reproducible R tools, web platforms or GUI workflows.

ranked.headline: Constraint-based and generative models infer metabolic fluxes and enzyme kinetics
ranked.summary: Recent methods pair thermodynamic, Arrhenius, and latent-space constraints with metabolic models to predict fluxes and kinetics.

ranked.headline: Long-read and imputed resources capture genomic variation missed by reference-anchored…
ranked.summary: Reference-anchored genotyping and selection leave variation unresolved, and new canine, KIR and cattle methods address these gaps.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks expose ambiguity and metric limits in transcript and RNA modification calls
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks test how ambiguity, uncertainty and metric choice shape reported accuracy in transcriptome and direct RNA sequencing analysis tools.

ranked.headline: Head-to-head benchmarks of proteomics search software on hair and phosphoproteome data
ranked.summary: Public proteomics reuse increasingly depends on automated run metadata and transparent comparison of search software performance.

ranked.headline: Compiled-language rewrites accelerate VCF filtering and variant effect annotation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints report 12.2x and 22-24x speedups over bcftools and Ensembl VEP on public genome datasets.

ranked.headline: Conductance models link chloride and Ca2+ channel fluxes to neuronal excitability
ranked.summary: Recent conductance-based models resolve chloride-driven seizure transitions and calcium-dependent firing regimes at network and single-cell scales.

ranked.headline: Generative and pretrained models applied to fMRI diagnosis, imagery decoding, and neural…
ranked.summary: Reuse of generative and pretrained architectures across neural datasets is being tested for diagnosis, decoding, and data-scaling behavior in brain models.

ranked.headline: Agents grounded in executable tools and declarative configs for omics analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple LLM agents and automated pipelines to containerized execution and declarative configuration for omics and workflow tasks.
